# Chat (OpenAI)

In the ChatGPT desktop app, OpenAI calls a [session][industry.session] a chat ([Remote connections][o10]). OpenAI has renamed one heading from thread to task to chat, keeping all three anchors, so its documentation still mixes the three for the same thing. In VS Code, by contrast, a [chat][microsoft.chat] is only a part of a session.
